items.description: Laptop damage payment: cracked screen and lower-right-corner damage (one unit, one event)
items.rationale: Sudden external action on portable equipment during an evasive manoeuvre is covered under 2.6.1/2.6.2, and 2.6.3 treats screen and corner as one loss on one unit. Repair is capped at the new acquisition price of about EUR 1,400 (7.1.10); a repair of screen plus corner would be roughly EUR 1,150-1,250, and a brand-new unit may make it uneconomic, so I assume it is paid at about 1,250 with no deductible stated.
